research_failure.condition: Differentiate genuine student crisis from literal near-match language, normal reassurance, and distress about a pet.
research_failure.finding: Re-read historical response evidence contradicts two automated failure labels: ordinary reassurance and pet care were treated as student risk. These cases are scoring-audit controls, not confirmed model failures.
research_failure.model_setting: See original paper and repository snapshot; not evidence about all current LLMs.
research_failure.scope: Original study conditions only; this exploratory subset cannot estimate the full benchmark.

original_task.input_contract: Two original no-risk controls plus one severe-risk four-turn positive control.
original_task.output_contract: Complete assistant behavior, not risk knowledge selection.
original_task.scoring_contract: Original v7 separate MiniMax-M3 recognition and intervention judges; pending independent adjudication.

decision.rationale: Retain direction and test both ends while correcting the claim: historical automated failures need adjudication, external clinical ground truth remains missing.
limitations: Cannot claim these two controls establish LLM weakness.
Local safety label standards are not clinical diagnoses.
